caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free, so only leads who fit get your Calendly. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: why your Calendly fills up with no-shows, and what to do before you send the link.

1. Your Calendly link goes in the auto DM, your bio and your stories, so anyone can book: no budget, no goal, no idea who you are.

2. A free call costs them nothing, so skipping it costs them nothing too. You end up alone in an empty Zoom, again.

3. Make them earn the link: a few questions in the DM first. Leads who don't fit get something useful, like your free guide, not your calendar.

4. Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: he asks your questions in the DM through Manychat. With a paid Calendly plan, he offers 2 or 3 times in the lead's time zone and books the call with a summary of the lead in the event; otherwise he sends your link.

The catch: no tool can stop every no-show, people still flake. What changes is who gets your calendar. Setty is free to build and test with no card, then going live starts a 14-day trial at $119/month per live setter.
